applicabilityBasis.summary: BOLD is a decentralized borrowing-protocol stablecoin minted against ETH and liquid-staking collateral and redeemed for collateral through immutable contracts. Its stablecoin-shaped design is payment-like, but no conventional legal issuer obligated to redeem a fixed monetary value is identified, so GENIUS applicability remains unclear.

genius.notes: Re-reviewed 2026-10-07. Liquity AG identifies itself as a software studio and disclaims protocol operation, control of collateral and any holder claim against a person or legal entity. BOLD holders can exchange tokens for dollar-valued crypto collateral less fees; this documented redemption mechanism does not establish an issuer obligation to deliver currency or bank-deposit monetary value. Public protocol materials disclose collateral types, but no conventional issuer reserve-report or monthly attestation hub was located. No public GENIUS authorization or route was identified. Prudential implementation remains proposed; the September 30 Treasury rule establishes SCRC procedures, not a general effective-date trigger. The general statutory fallback date is 2027-01-18; DASP timelines are separately specified by the Act. Removed the old undated market-cap assertion. No legal issuerEntity is identified or added.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, the opened regulator materials, directories, protocol disclosures and token/name-specific official-domain searches did not identify a public GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, official GENIUS application or registered foreign-issuer exception for BOLD. No token-specific GENIUS enforcement action was located in the searched domains. This is a bounded public-evidence finding, not proof that no unpublished application exists; generic bank-charter or virtual-currency licensing would not establish these statuses.
